record.paper_title: Higher Rank Brill-Noether Theory and Coherent Systems: Open Questions
record.original_question: For which ranks n >= 2 and for which smooth curves C does Mercat's Conjecture Cliff_n(C) = Cliff_1(C) hold, and more generally what good lower bounds can one prove for Cliff_n(C)?

evidence.quote: Question 3.5. For which values of n ≥ 2 and for which curves does Mercat’s Conjecture hold? More generally, find a good lower bound for Cliffn(C).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a smooth irreducible projective curve of genus $g \geq 2$ over the complex numbers. For an integer $n \geq 1$, define the rank-$n$ Clifford index of $C$ by
$$\mathrm{Cliff}_n(C) = \min\left\{ \frac{1}{n}\bigl(\deg E - 2(h^0(E) - n)\bigr) \;\Big|\; E \text{ a vector bundle on } C \text{ of rank } n,\ h^0(E) \geq n+1,\ \mu(E) \leq g-1 \right\},$$
where $\mu(E) = \deg(E)/\mathrm{rk}(E)$. For $n=1$ this recovers the classical Clifford index $\mathrm{Cliff}_1(C)$ of the curve.

Mercat's Conjecture asserts that $\mathrm{Cliff}_n(C) = \mathrm{Cliff}_1(C)$ for every $n \geq 2$.

Determine for which integers $n \geq 2$ and for which smooth projective curves $C$ Mercat's Conjecture holds. More generally, establish good lower bounds for $\mathrm{Cliff}_n(C)$ valid for all $n \geq 2$ and all such curves $C$.
artifact.category_tag: Higher rank Brill-Noether theory / Mercat's conjecture
artifact.status_search_result: Mercat's conjecture is known to hold in rank 2 for generic curves of every genus (Bakker–Farkas), but fails on a divisor in M_g for odd g. For ranks n ≥ 3 (and n ≥ 4), explicit counterexamples have been constructed using Lazarsfeld–Mukai bundles on curves lying on K3 surfaces. The general problem of characterizing for which n and which C the conjecture holds, and finding sharp lower bounds for Cliff_n(C), remains open.

status_evidence.title: The Mercat Conjecture for stable rank 2 vector bundles on generic curves
status_evidence.snippet: Mercat's conjecture was proved for generic curves of every genus in rank 2; for odd g a divisor in M_g exists along which it fails.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture holds in rank 2 generically but fails along a divisor for odd genus.

status_evidence.title: Counterexamples to Mercat's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Counterexamples to Mercat's conjecture in rank n for n ≥ 4 using curves on K3 surfaces.

status_evidence.title: Higher rank Clifford indices of curves on a K3 surface
status_evidence.snippet: Restrictions of Lazarsfeld–Mukai bundles yield counterexamples to Mercat's conjecture in ranks 3 and 4 for curves on K3 surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture fails for curves on K3 surfaces in ranks > 2.
